items.text:
Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 arrive on AWS

• Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on AWS, offering faster, cheaper, and higher-capability AI for technical and high-risk work.
• Gemini can automatically pull and send personal Drive or email content to human reviewers, even without explicit tags, in a probabilistic manner.
• Nvidia's shares fell more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board announced an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive suspected of spying for China.

items.text:
Google says your Gmail and Drive files can reach Gemini's human reviewers.

• Google's help page says connected Gmail and Drive content can go to human reviewers.
• Testers found Gemini pulls files in the background, without @Drive or @Gmail tags.
• Google's own advice: don't connect apps with information you wouldn't want a reviewer to see.

Do this: Check Gemini's Connected Apps and switch off anything holding confidential information.

Your take: Would you connect your email to an AI? Tell us in the comments.

Save this for when you need it.

items.text:
Anthropic's new Claude Fable 5.2 is out, and cheaper than before.

• Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are now on Amazon Bedrock.
• Fable 5.2 costs $8 per million input tokens, down from $10, and answers 30% faster.
• In testing it solved two open physics problems about black holes, Anthropic says.

Our read: If you build with Claude, the same work now costs less.

Your take: Would a cheaper AI change how you work? Tell us in the comments.
